d: Short, charcoal-grey hair with a smooth texture is styled into a side-swept fringe and a small ponytail tied with a black ribbon and a miniature naval cap. The eyes are a dark chocolate brown with a soft, neutral expression, set on a youthful face with an adolescent maturity. A slender build is dressed in a white sailor-style tunic featuring blue trim, a blue collar, and a yellow scarf tucked under a metallic anchor ornament, paired with black thigh-high stockings. Signature details include a large, grey mechanical naval armament assembly mounted on the back and held in the hand.
